# Selected public DSH GUI

Source: [DeepSeek Harness d743267](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/d743267388641bc76f17c45ce8b4c231aed1d32c), public 0.2.1-alpha.2 baseline. The root MIT notice remains in LICENSE. CosmoKit/Schemastery carry their upstream notices where selected. SOURCE.json records every selected source hash, original public path and any adaptation. These supplier files retain their own licensing; Augmentor's resale restriction does not relabel them.

The actual AppFrame, sidebar, conversation shell, composer, model chooser, chat, Trajectory, workspace picker, approval/question flows, goal bar, controls and CSS are copied from public upstream. We select presentation dependencies and local type contracts, not the DSH owner, API bridge, account/analytics plugins or backend. InputBar has one nonvisual import substitution to avoid loading Cordis's image service. The small image media predicate is selected verbatim from the public upstream service source. The folder browser's English dictionary in the adapter is derived from ui-directory-picker-browse/src/client/index.ts at this same public ref.

The October 11 session-control selection adds five verbatim public files from ui-workspace/session-actions: PinSession, RenameSession, ForkSession, ArchiveSession and RowActionToast. Together with the previously selected original rename/archive dialogs, pin-order helpers and view filters, they retain the supplier menus, hover controls, confirmation and notices. The session-control selection has 345 hashed files; all preceding 340 records and supplier bytes remain unchanged.

The separately authored dsh-app.jsx/controller/projection/payload files translate Pi Host data into public component props. Pi's existing AgentSession is the only execution owner. This source selection is not a complete DSH backend or a claim of complete feature parity. See docs/DSH-GUI-ON-PI.md.

The attachment follow-up adds thirteen verbatim ui-attachment files (cards, rail, drop overlay, historical images, labels and CSS), bringing the GUI selection to 358. The preceding 345 records/bytes remain unchanged. A separate twelve-file pure public storage/codec selection lives in packages/runtime/vendor/dsh-attachment, retaining MIT licensing and original/adapted hashes. Its only changes are local import paths and NodeNext suffixes; no supplier service owner is copied.

The original-command follow-up adds **28 verbatim public files**, bringing the selection to **386**. They are the original ui-input-trigger menu/controller/detection/reducer, ui-commands grouping/presentation/model-option popup and the composer’s coordinate mapping/chip dependencies plus pure file-reference grammar. All preceding 358 records and bytes remain unchanged. The existing InputBar import substitution remains the only supplier adaptation; no new supplier visual source or CSS is changed. Independently authored dsh-command-menu.mjs binds Pi authority, draft revisions and existing actions; the copied generic popup is protected from IME acceptance by an authored event boundary. This does not connect file mention chips or the entire DSH command catalogue.

The original-settings follow-up adds **18 verbatim public files**, bringing the selection to **404**. These supply the settings shell/section navigation, trigger and close chrome, store, General section, Appearance selector and version row. Their CSS is unchanged. The optional desktop-update presentation is copied because the shell imports it, but no Electron bridge/updater is connected. The independently authored Pi section registrants keep existing scoped reasoning/MCP handlers and observation policy; DSH account, onboarding, configuration-file editing and plugin installation remain unbound. No DSH backend or analytics owner is selected.

The October 12 file-reference selection adds three public ui-reference records: the manifest and dictionaries are verbatim; the index exports original pure file-row/breadcrumb/value helpers for Pi binding with a marked modification notice. Its Cordis apply is not mounted. The total GUI selection is 407; all preceding 404 file bodies remain unchanged. Original chips, CSS and menu components are reused. Runtime path-only discovery and ordinary mention guidance are separately recorded under packages/runtime/vendor/dsh-file-reference. [Qualification and remaining reference work](../../../../docs/HARNESS-FILE-REFERENCES.md).

The October 12 file-preview selection adds **75 public files**, bringing the GUI selection to **482**. Original right-sidebar/dock planners, stores, persistence, text/code/Markdown/image readers and CSS are reused. Of the preceding 407 bodies, 406 remain identical; the Markdown primitive has a marked optional remote-image suppression flag. The new Markdown reader has a marked optional authenticated image vocabulary. Both preserve default upstream rendering and retain original hashes. Original persistence uses pinned MIT zod 4.4.3. No supplier Cordis/backend owner is mounted. The selected runtime page cutter has separate MIT provenance under packages/runtime/vendor/dsh-preview. [Scope and qualification](../../../../docs/HARNESS-FILE-PREVIEWS.md).

The Context sidebar follow-up adds one verbatim public tab-registry.ts, bringing the selection to 483. All preceding 482 bodies/CSS remain unchanged. Original registry/guide/placement registrations bind UI-only slots, with pinned MIT picomatch 4.0.7 from the public baseline lock. [Scope and qualification](../../../../docs/CONTEXT-SIDEBAR.md).

The October 12 PDF selection adds thirteen public modules, bringing 483 to 496: twelve verbatim bodies and one marked local-worker runtime adaptation. Original page/text/zoom/tab widgets and CSS remain in use; PDF.js/font/decoder notices remain separate. [Scope and qualification](../../../../docs/HARNESS-PDF-PREVIEWS.md).

The October 12 Office selection adds eleven public modules, bringing 496 to 507: ten verbatim bodies, including both CSS files and the document hook contract, and one marked unavailable-service locale adaptation. Original registration, cache, face/store, font warning, PDF child and tab lifetimes run through a Pi UI-only seat. The separately selected MIT provider/queue/output helpers and MPL-2.0 LibreOffice kit/Wasm engine retain distinct source/licence records. [Scope and qualification](../../../../docs/HARNESS-OFFICE-PREVIEWS.md).

The October 12 spreadsheet selection adds twenty public files, bringing 507 to 527: sixteen spreadsheet modules, the original FortuneSheet MIT notice and three original FortuneSheet/ExcelJS patches. Eighteen bodies are verbatim. Marked parse.ts uses a fixed same-origin module worker; marked xlsx.ts omits missing/invalid optional default row heights to preserve real scrolling, retaining valid point conversion. Original grid/formula bar/sheet tabs/warnings/Retry/CSS remain in use, with stored formulas uncomputed. Exact public patches apply only in build-local overlays, with original/patched hashes and a separate worker graph in compiled provenance. SheetJS Apache-2.0 and the other MIT browser notices remain separate. [Scope and qualification](../../../../docs/HARNESS-SPREADSHEET-PREVIEWS.md).

The October 12 HTML selection adds fourteen public files, bringing 527 to 541: nine HTML modules, the original General developer-tools row/CSS, preference class/schema and settings manifest. Twelve are verbatim; marked HtmlBody accepts an optional opaque-frame transport and DeveloperToolsRow accepts an optional disabled gate. Original static sanitizer, finite packer, bootstrap, resource subscriptions, dictionaries and CSS remain in use. All preceding supplier records remain unchanged. DOMPurify 3.4.16 retains its exact attribution and Apache-2.0 selection from the offered Apache/MPL licence alternatives. [Contracts and qualification](../../../../docs/HARNESS-HTML-PREVIEWS.md).

The keyboard selection adds 22 public files, bringing 541 to 563: original shortcut registry/DOM/protocol, reference/recorder/row/store/locale/CSS, sidebar commands/focus and layout shortcut dictionary. Twenty are verbatim; marked binding.ts admits guarded Linux browser two-modifier combinations, and marked locales.ts describes actual private Host/disabled preference behavior and delivery limits. All prior records remain unchanged. A separately compiled closed pure protocol graph retains MIT text and source/bundle hashes; registrants receive UI-only Pi seats. [Contracts and qualification](../../../../docs/HARNESS-SHORTCUTS.md).

The October 13 request-numbering correction marks one existing MIT TrajectoryView file for an optional recorded-only binding. Pi enables it so unmatched SDK assistant/abort receipts stay in the ledger without fabricated provider request controls or cumulative request usage. Default upstream inference and original layout/CSS remain unchanged. SOURCE.json retains the original SHA-256 and records the adapted body; selection stays 580 files. [Scope and qualification](../../../../docs/TRAJECTORY-REQUEST-NUMBERING.md).

Original MIT session-log export presentation: selected package manifest, document-relative route, download controller, Header More menu, dialog/locales and Header CSS are verbatim at the same pinned public ref. Augmentor injects authenticated preparation and a short-lived one-use download URL with an Augmentor filename. Pi archive assembly/lifetime are authored adapters; no DSH Host serializer/agent is imported.

October 16 MX feedback marks ModelSelect for optional ordered pins/hidden filtering and top-first opening, plus InputBar for optional toolbar placement of the original context meter. Original/default rendering remains available; upstream hashes and current adapted hashes stay in SOURCE.json. The separate Model Picker Augmented settings-card CSS retains the owner’s MIT 1.1.2 archive notice in compiled GUI notices. See docs/HARNESS-MX-FEEDBACK.md.

The configured-catalogue follow-up marks ModelSelect and its stylesheet for an optional credentials-required sublabel.
